title: Casa de las Flores
subtitle: A Private Tropical Sanctuary
description:
True privacy is the ultimate luxury. Nestled within the secure gates of Puerto Aventuras, Casa de las Flores is a botanical sanctuary that redefines tropical living. Located just five minutes from the pristine Caribbean sands, this estate is entirely enveloped by mature, lush gardens, offering a level of absolute seclusion that is virtually impossible to find elsewhere on the Riviera Maya.

Spanning over 3,000 sq ft of thoughtfully crafted living space, the residence is designed to balance entertaining with intimate family moments. The fluid, open-plan dining area seamlessly connects to a newly renovated, fully equipped chef's kitchen. Two distinct living rooms provide versatile spaces for relaxation, while the effortless indoor-outdoor flow draws you toward the private pool, the serene centerpiece of this verdant retreat.

The home features five generous bedrooms, two and a half bathrooms, and a fully independent studio. This rare configuration offers exceptional flexibility, whether accommodating extended family, hosting staff, or generating premium vacation rental income.

For the visionary buyer, this estate presents an unprecedented expansion opportunity. While Casa de las Flores already commands an impressive 10,480 sq ft lot, the adjacent parcel (Lot 13) is also available (an additional 6,781 sq ft for $650,000 USD). Acquiring both properties allows for the creation of a monumental, custom compound.

Delivered turnkey and perfectly ready to be lived in, this is more than a residence, it is the best-kept secret of Puerto Aventuras, waiting to be claimed.
highlights: Swimming pool and outdoor entertaining areas
